label: Crumbling Blast

pieces.Text: A herald of the horn can use his horn to create a devastating shock wave of energy. Once per day, he can sound a note on the horn that functions like a horn of blasting
A herald of the horn can use his horn to create a devastating shock wave of energy. Twice per day, he can sound a note on the horn that functions like a greater horn of blasting
Unlike an actual horn of blasting, this ability does not carry the risk of destroying the horn.
